The build

Standard on every pod

Pine roof edge panels and black hexagon bitumen shingles are included on every pod type. From there, the specification is yours to shape.

Specification

What goes into your pod

The choices below make up your build. The price of each option is listed in the section that follows.

Base dimensions
2.4m wide by 4.8m long. Pine roof edge panels and black hexagon bitumen shingles included with all pod types.
Exterior and wall build
Pinewood, or Thermowood with 48mm thick walls, or fully insulated with premium 130mm wall thickness, 128mm sides, 120mm front and rear, dual 14mm pine cladding with 100mm stone wool insulation.
Floor build
Standard 30mm pinewood floor boards, or 160mm premium insulated with 28mm pine floorboards over 100mm stone wool and a structural base.
Entry door
Classic double door with double glazed squared windows and secure lock and key, included with non insulated. Or Danish style double glazed entry door with tall sleek glass panels, thick timber frame and stainless steel lock, included with the insulated pod.
Entrance
Optional 1m terrace with 0.6m covered porch in 28mm impregnated timber decking. Optional 1m front terrace, a timber decking platform included with the insulated pod, taking the total terrace depth to 1.6m alongside the porch.
Internal layout
Open plan, or a 1.5m bedroom partition set 1.5m from the rear for a separate sleeping area.
Rear wall
Optional half glass double glazed fixed rear window, a 26mm unit with two panes and a 6-14-6 insulating air gap.
Finish
Optional stain or paint outside only, or a full timber treatment inside and outside for cladding, trim and interior walls.
